title: 148 Colours
summary: A Gerhard Richter colour chart in which the artist mixes nothing: the swatches are the committee-named CSS colours, resolved live by your browser and ordered by chance.
mechanism: The CSS Color Module Level 4 named-colour list is rendered swatch by swatch with backgroundColor and read back via getComputedStyle, chance-shuffled per visit; the engine supplies every pixel, nothing is stored, no network.
references: CSS Color Module Level 4 named colours (W3C)
